facts.text: Danny, the freezer's stocked with enough for the whole winter. Help yourself to the ice cream, it's the good stuff.
facts.why: Hallorann never says this. On the kitchen tour he shows Wendy and Danny the walk-in freezer and says 'You folks could eat here for a year and never have the same menu twice.' He then asks Wendy if he can give Danny ice cream and Danny picks chocolate. The line on the menu is invented.
facts.fix: You folks could eat here for a year and never have the same menu twice.

vibe.verdict: Right hotel, right yellow poster and the Jack face, but the food and the words stay generic and miss the bar and the pantry tour.
missing: Lloyd at the Gold Room bar ('Your money's no good here')
Red rum on the bathroom door
Hallorann's pantry tour (Danny asks for French fries and ketchup)
Jack through the broken bathroom door ('Here's Johnny')
ideas: Swap 'Gold Room spiced nuts' for 'Danny's French fries and ketchup' with the note 'I think we can manage that too, Doc.'
Rename 'Gold Room bourbon old fashioned' to 'Lloyd's bourbon, on the house' with the note 'Orders from the house.'
Swap the prawn cocktail note for 'Red rum. Read it in the mirror.'
Swap 'Wendy's breakfast in bed tray' note for 'Toast, juice and coffee, and a typewriter full of the same sentence.'
